She was also the only known daughter of [[Gibeon]], the mother of [[Amethio]], and the wife of [[Cervantis]]. ==History== [[File:Amethio and Maria.png|150px|left|thumb|Maria and young [[Amethio]] in a boat]] ===Pre-series=== When her son, [[Amethio]], was a child, he and Maria spent a lot of time together, such as by going on a boat trip or playing at a beach. At some point, she died in a car accident, but Amethio was too young to even remember it well. ==={{aniseries|HZ}}=== In ''[[HZ083|The Truth Revealed!]]'', Maria was first shown in a portrait in front of the entrance of [[Amethio's mansion]]. It caught [[Zirc]] and [[Onia]]'s attention, and Amethio explained that she was his mother and that she died in a car accident when he was young, but reassured them not to worry. Some portraits of her alongside [[Cervantis]] and Amethio were seen in the mansion. In ''[[HZ104|Charcadet's Wish]]'', she appears again in a flashback, asking {{TP|Amethio|Charcadet}} to protect her son, Amethio, soon after both met for the first time. {{-}} ==Character== Little is known about Maria, but she appeared to be very caring and loving to her son. {{-}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{pearl color}}|bordercolor={{ghost color dark}} |ja=藤井ゆきよ ''Yukiyo Fujii'' |he=טליה ברקאי ''Talya Barkai'' |en= }} ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{Pearl color}}; border:3px solid #{{ghost color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{grey color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{grey color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{grey color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | マリア ''Maria'' | Possibly from ''{{wp|marialite}}'' |} {{-}} ==References== ==Related articles== {{Explorers}} {{Pokémon Horizons characters|Pearl}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Animation characters]] [[Category:Female characters]] [[Category:Mothers]] [[Category:Deceased characters]] [[es:Maria]] [[it:Madre di Amethio]] [[ja:マリア (2023年版)]] [[zh:玛丽亚]]
